
---
title: "Artists"
---

```{r}
source("data_prep.R")

library(htmltools)
library(tidyverse)

# Find available lyrics files
lyrics_files <- list.files(
  "song_lyrics",
  pattern = "\\.(csv|txt)$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

lyrics_ids <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(lyrics_files))
))

# Alphabetical list of artists
artist_list <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(artist), artist != "") %>%
  group_by(artist) %>%
  summarise(
    track_count = n_distinct(sort),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tolower(artist))

# Build a collapsed, expandable section for each artist
artist_sections <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(artist_list)), function(i) {

  artist_name <- artist_list$artist[i]

  tracks <- df %>%
    filter(artist == artist_name) %>%
    arrange(cdseq, sort)

  tags$section(
    class = "artist-section",

    tags$details(
      class = "artist-details",

      # Artist name and track count form the clickable row
      tags$summary(
        class = "artist-summary",

        tags$span(
          class = "artist-name",
          as.character(artist_name)
        ),

        tags$span(
          class = "artist-count",
          paste(artist_list$track_count[i], "tracks")
        )
      ),

      # Tracks appear only when the artist is expanded
      tags$ol(
        class = "artist-track-list",

        lapply(seq_len(nrow(tracks)), function(j) {

          track <- tracks[j, ]

          song_id <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(track$sort))
          song_title <- as.character(track$songname)
          album_name <- as.character(track$`album name`)

          # Link to lyrics if a matching file exists
          title_element <- if (
            !is.na(song_id) && song_id %in% lyrics_ids
          ) {
            tags$a(
              href = paste0("lyrics.html#lyrics-", song_id),
              song_title
            )
          } else {
            tags$span(song_title)
          }

          tags$li(
            class = "artist-track",

            tags$div(
              class = "artist-track-main",

              title_element,

              tags$span(
                class = "track-duration",
                as.character(track$time)
              )
            ),

            tags$div(
              class = "artist-track-album",

              tags$a(
                href = paste0("albums.html#album-", track$cdseq),
                album_name
              ),

              " · ",
              as.character(track$`psux year`)
            )
          )
        })
      )
    )
  )
})

# Artist search and expandable list
artist_page <- tags$div(
  id = "artist-list",

  tags$label(
    `for` = "artist-search",
    "Search artists"
  ),

  tags$input(
    id = "artist-search",
    type = "search",
    placeholder = "Type an artist name...",
    autocomplete = "off"
  ),

  tags$div(
    id = "artist-sections",
    artist_sections
  )
)

# Filter artists as the user types
artist_search_script <- tags$script(HTML("
(function () {
  function initArtistSearch() {
    const search = document.getElementById('artist-search');
    const container = document.getElementById('artist-sections');

    if (!search || !container) return;

    if (search.dataset.initialized === 'true') return;
    search.dataset.initialized = 'true';

    search.addEventListener('input', function () {
      const query = search.value.toLowerCase().trim();

      container.querySelectorAll('.artist-section').forEach(function (section) {
        const heading = section.querySelector('.artist-name');
        const name = heading ? heading.textContent.toLowerCase() : '';

        section.style.display = name.includes(query) ? '' : 'none';
      });
    });
  }

  function start() {
    initArtistSearch();

    if (!document.getElementById('artist-search')) {
      setTimeout(start, 100);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
"))

htmltools::browsable(
  tagList(
    artist_page,
    artist_search_script
  )
)
```
